messages:
Priya (AE): Quick sync — PayMesh POC scope. Customer wants two main flows: fraud/chargeback classifier + billing reconciliation/invoice parsing. We need to align endpoints, success metrics, timeline, pricing options (hosted vs committed Dedicated), and answer their security questionnaire. Can SE + Security join?

Tom (SE): On it. Can you paste the sample payloads they shared and an expected QPS/latency SLO?

Ana (Solutions): They attached a short SOW. High level: 3 endpoints: 1) /invoice-parse -> extracts line items + vendor id, 2) /reconcile -> matches payments to invoices (fuzzy match), 3) /chargeback-classify -> binary + reason. Target load ~ 5 QPS peak, interactive flows 99p < 300ms. Success criteria: >=95% F1 on classifier eval, >=90% reconciliation match rate on held-out set, and cost target under $0.003/token aggregated.

Jason (SE): For chargeback classifier we should stream logits + include top-3 reasons for audit. For reconcile I suggest hybrid: embeddings for quick candidate retrieval + a lightweight reranker. Example quickstart curl for invoice parse:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoice-parse \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' \n  -d '{"document": "<base64-pdf>", "options": {"extract_line_items": true}}'
```

Tom (SE): Pricing note — rough internal estimate for the POC traffic: hosted pay-as-you-go ~ $2.4k/month (including generation + embeddings) at expected QPS and payload sizes. Committed Dedicated (small pool) estimate ~ $8.5k/month — will refine with pricing team. These are placeholders until we get actual token counts.

Priya (AE): Customer asked about committed discounts and whether we can cap egress logs. Also flagged data residency (EU), SOC2, and KMS/HSM. They prefer a monthly committed arrangement but need security answers to proceed.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire uploaded: internal link https://redwood.internal/sec/paymesh-questionnaire — assigned to @Maria (Security).

Maria (Security): We can host in EU regions and integrate with customer KMS for Private or Dedicated. HSM for Private deployment requires legal signoff; I'll start the paperwork. Will aim to complete questionnaire answers in ~10 business days. Log retention: we can configure per-customer retention windows; need to confirm exact retention period they want.

Ana (Solutions): Customer will provide: 500 labeled invoices (csv) and ~200 chargeback labeled examples, plus mapping keys for payment rails. Need a clear label schema from SEs — e.g., reconciliation match confidence thresholds and label categories for chargebacks.

Jason (SE): Action items: 1) I'll publish a quickstart repo + example prompts + prompt templates for invoice parsing and classifier. 2) Tom to produce a tokenized-cost estimate for hosted vs committed (use 100k requests/month baseline). 3) Maria to return the security questionnaire answers. 4) Priya to share SOW and sample payloads in this thread. Propose a sync Monday 10:00am PT to lock scope.

Tom (SE): For the eval plan: ask customer for a 500-example eval set with gold labels for each endpoint. We'll run initial baseline (open model) -> tweak prompts + small tuning if needed. Recommend 4-week POC to include buffer: Week 0 kick, Week 1 stubs & infra, Week 2 baseline evals + prompt tuning, Week 3 integration + acceptance testing, Week 4 buffer for security/legal. Customer requested 3 weeks but I'd push 4.

Priya (AE): Agreed, I will propose 4 weeks in the call. Locking Mon 10am PT. I'll attach the SOW + their security doc after this thread and @mention folks in the meeting invite. :thumbsup:
